provenance.citation: J. Chem. Inf. Model. 2024 review snippet reported experimental Rg range about 2.5-4.0 nm for alpha-synuclein monomer ensembles.
provenance.notes: Broad experimental compilation rather than one canonical value.

provenance.citation: FUS low-complexity conformational studies and sequence-matched polymer analyses support expanded ensemble with Rg in high-40s to mid-50s A regime for long LCD constructs.
provenance.notes: Not exact 1-214 construct SAXS anchor; narrowed from prior broad range using literature-constrained LCD expansion regime.

provenance.citation: SASBDB molecule/4796 snippet reports hNRNPA1 LCD Rg 24.4 +/- 0.4 A
provenance.notes: Construct-aligned LCD anchor tightened from SAXS database entry; non-Rg observables remain proxy-assisted.

provenance.citation: Biophysical reports for TDP-43 CTD indicate diffusion-derived Rg about 2.8 nm for disordered CTD ensemble.
provenance.notes: CTD size anchor tightened from reported disordered-diffusion estimate; remaining observables are still proxy-guided.

provenance.citation: PMCID review snippet reports p53 TAD Rg 28.7 A from NMR/MD integration for residues 1-93 scale.
provenance.notes: Construct-matched TAD size anchor tightened; contact/helicity bands remain literature-informed proxy ranges.

provenance.citation: SAXS-based value reported for tau K18 around Rg = 38 +/- 3 A.

provenance.citation: Ensemble benchmark literature reported Sic1 Rg around 29.5 A.
